---
name: cpp-review
description: Review C++20 code for correctness and maintainability, with file/line evidence. Use when asked for a C++ review, not for runtime safety approval.
---
# C++ review — beginner skill
1. Read the requested C++ file and relevant headers.
2. Identify at most five substantiated findings, with exact source lines.
3. Clearly separate confirmed defect, hypothesis and missing information.
4. Do not edit files unless explicitly requested.
5. Output: file:line | finding | evidence | suggested test.
See `references/checklist.md` for the detailed checklist.
